newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Vneshekonombank has $300 mln French credit.
newsitem.headline: Russian Vneshekonombank has $300 mln French credit.

text.p: Russia's Vneshekonombank said on Friday it had signed an agreement with a consortium of French banks on a 1.5 billion franc investment credit.
It said the credit agreement had been signed on beneficial terms for Russia to finance deliveries of a wide range of equipment and services by French firms over two to 10 years.

Vneshekonombank said the French consortium comprised Societe Generale, Banque Nationale de Paris and Credit Lyonnais and others, including Russian-owned Banque Commerciale pour l'Europe du Nord (Eurobank).
Vneshekonombank said a series of projects to be financed by the credit, mostly in the social sphere, including the reconstruction of Moscow State University and of the state library.
Vneshekonombank replaced the Soviet foreign trade bank of the same name and serviecs Russia's foreign debts, inherited from the former Soviet Union.
